Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, Joyce Hunter, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Announcement of GCN Pledge Month 3. Discussion of openly-gay Harry Britt's loss to Nancy Pelosi for the position of Californian Democratic member of Congress, discussion of gay politicians and the gay voting block COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 4. Vice-President George Bush finally takes a stance on AIDS prevention and education, but only in the private sphere, also the outspokenness of Surgeon General Everett Koop 5. AIDS organizations in Puerto Rico COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 6. Anti-gay prejudice and heterosexual bias 7. News Watch, Georgetown University persuades a Maryland state representative a bill to give them funding for an expansion, after the university refused to comply with Washington DC's human rights law 8. Idaho requires those applying for a marriage license to be tested for HIV 9. Moscow, USSR opens an anonymous AIDS testing site for foreigners and those who have had sex with foreigners 10. Britain's Princess Diana opens the country's first AIDS ward, in order to dispel myth of infection by close contact COMMERCIAL: 10th Annual Awards Evening for the Fund for Human Dignity 11. Sports Report, on location with The Times Squares, a gay-oriented square dance group 12. Lavender Health, interview with Karen Solomon, a coordinator of the AIDS Counseling and Testing Site of the NYC Department of Health, discussion of HIV test 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of Broadway production of Harvey Fierstein's three one-acts, "Safe Sex" 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, interview with [Frederick] Davies, star of the one-man show, "The Great Truman Capote" 3. Episode of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "Catching Up is Hard to Do" 4. Closing credits
